info.name: PRISM · ALL Backend APIs (via NGINX)
info.description: Every REST endpoint of every backend service, generated from the LIVE OpenAPI of each app. One front door: NGINX terminates TLS on :8443 and the gateway routes by prefix (/access, /orchestrator, /atlas, /vocx, /pulse, else Register). Bodies are TYPE-correct scaffolding — replace values before sending. Sending requires an environment: select 'PRISM — All APIs' (or the E2E environments, which share the same variables).

request.description:
Streams inline-stored bytes; for object-storage-backed documents, redirects to a
freshly-signed URL (or streams through the API if configured); redirects to an http(s)
``storage_uri``; otherwise returns the reference. Metadata-only records 404.

Stitches a company's whole footprint onto one response — the payoff of the
entity-centric (not deal-centric) model: how many deals, across which businesses,
with what current financials, latest interactions and open intelligence.

request.description:

lender. Derived live from ``syndication_lenders`` so it never drifts from the source
(the ATLAS mock even carried matrix-vs-text conflicts — the reason not to store it).

POST /v1/internal/cpcs-checklists — Prepare / complete the CP/CS checklist (maker)
POST /v1/internal/cpcs-checklists/{checklist_id}/approve — Approve the CP/CS checklist (checker; must differ from the maker)
POST /v1/internal/cpcs-checklists/{checklist_id}/return — Return the CP/CS checklist to its maker (checker; with reasons)

request.description:
RETURN-TO-MAKER: the checker sends a Completed checklist back for amendment instead
of approving or rejecting it. The row becomes 'Returned' (immutable reasons in the
audit trail + note); the maker AMENDS by submitting the NEXT checklist_version — the
returned version stays on the record untouched, so every iteration of the checklist is
permanently reviewable.

item.name: POST /v1/internal/decisions/deliveries/claim — Reconciler: atomically claim due pending deliveries (with a lease)
GET /v1/internal/decisions/deliveries/stats — Reconciler: delivery counts + aged-pending gauge (for metrics/alerts)
GET /v1/internal/decisions/{workflow_id} — Read the recorded decision for a workflow
POST /v1/internal/decisions/{workflow_id}/delivery — Reconciler: mark a delivery applied / retry (backoff) / dead
POST /v1/internal/decisions/{workflow_id}/redrive — Recover a dead-lettered delivery back to pending (Admin, audited)

request.description:
Return a ``dead`` delivery to ``pending`` so the reconciler picks it up again — the
operator recovery path for a decision dead-lettered by a (mis)judged terminal state.

Redrive re-activates a financial decision, so it is a HUMAN ADMIN action, not a service
one: it requires a verified Admin identity in the delegated context (svc_workflows is only
the transport), a MANDATORY recovery reason, and it writes an IMMUTABLE audit event that
names the admin, the reason, any ticket reference, and — crucially — the PREVIOUS
dead-letter cause before it is cleared, so the recovery is fully explainable after the fact.
Clears the lease/token/error and resets attempts. A no-op (404) if there is no dead row.

item.name: POST /v1/internal/handover-packages — MAKER prepares the Advaya handover package (does NOT advance the stage)
POST /v1/internal/handover-packages/{lending_id}/approve — CHECKER approves the handover (different person) and advances the stage
POST /v1/internal/handover-packages/{lending_id}/return — CHECKER returns the handover package to its maker (with reasons)

request.description:
RETURN-TO-MAKER on the handover: the checker sends a 'Prepared' package back for
amendment instead of approving it. The line does NOT move (it stays at 'Ready for
Disbursement'); the maker re-prepares — same row, fresh manifest + digest — and a
DIFFERENT checker approves the rebuilt package. Reasons are mandatory and audited.

request.description:
Soft-deactivate: a tenant is never hard-deleted because its business rows
reference ``tenant_id``. Sets ``is_active=false``; reactivate via PATCH.

item.name: POST /v1/assignments — Assign a user to a line (grants write on that line)
POST /v1/assignments/{assignment_id}/end — End an assignment (revokes line write)
GET /v1/authz/check — Can the calling user perform an operation (optionally on a line)?
POST /v1/leads/{lead_id}/convert — Convert a lead to a deal atomically (deal + lines + lead marked Converted, all-or-nothing)

request.description:
The transactional alternative to workflow-side compensation: the whole conversion
happens in THIS request's transaction, so a failure anywhere rolls the entire thing
back — no orphan deal or half-created product lines can ever survive. The Orchestrator
calls this on approval instead of creating rows step-by-step and undoing on error.

Authorization: ``push_lead_to_deals`` (BDRM+ per the matrix), AND — for a SCOPED
caller — EXACT write access to this Lead (assignment / own-book / vertical default),
not merely visibility of its company. Only an OPEN lead may be converted. The
Idempotency-Key (which the SDK sends) is honoured so a retry returns the first result
instead of creating a second deal.

GET /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id} — A run's live status (execution state + in-workflow stage)
POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/approve — Approve a pending human-in-the-loop workflow
POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/committee-decision — Record the Credit Committee decision (durable) and signal the workflow
POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/confirm-company — Answer an ambiguous-company confirmation on a parked VOX capture
POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/control — Cancel / return-for-information / resubmit a waiting run

request.description:
The lifecycle controls every real approval flow needs. Same trust posture as a
decision: verified identity, tenant binding, and the action is PERSISTED as an
immutable control record BEFORE the workflow is signalled — the signal is only a
wake-up, and the run verifies the record (fail-closed) before acting on it.

item.name: POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/document-received — Signal that a required document was received
POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/reject — Reject a pending human-in-the-loop workflow
POST /orchestrator/v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/revise-credit-note — Circulate a revised credit note to the committee (rework loop)

request.description:
Committee rework, completed: return-for-information parks the run, this delivers
the revised note (filed as the NEXT immutable credit_note version on every line),
resubmit restores the decision window. Verified identity + tenant binding; the run
must still be awaiting its decision.
